title: MSW Guns' Upswing
description: This datapack configures Soulslike Weaponry guns to have custom Better Combat melee swing animations with a fast 0.1-second (2-tick) upswing time.
body: Custom Better Combat with Better Combat templates that overrides for Soulslike Weaponry firearms (Hunter Pistol, Hunter Blunderbuss, Gatling Gun) that set a quick 0.1-second (2-tick) upswing animation.
